## The problem

What are you trying to do that the app doesn't do today? Lead with the pain, not the solution.

## Your proposed solution

How you imagine it working. Rough is fine.

## Notes

- Keep in mind the app's core rule: everything on screen is real data. Features built on fabricated or decorative numbers won't be accepted.
- Anything involving the Blubber character design or brand assets is out of scope for community PRs.
